rules.filter: no-nested-ternary, and any other diagnostic that isn't among the prepared project's own (rule and message, file by file, as diff.ts matches them), in the handoff and in every re-lint: a project that lints clean apart from this rule. rules.retryLoop: index.ts attemptFileFix: after each attempt, verify (the Oxlint pass on the file, in place, then the filter) and, while diagnostics remain that the agent didn't list on a `Left for review:` line and it didn't time out, another attempt with buildRetryPrompt, up to MAX_AGENT_ATTEMPTS; each attempt under AGENT_TIMEOUT_MS. Issues are matched by diff.ts at 9743dfcb (the mirror's v3), with each report's file as that linter run read it; a re-measurement rebuilds those files from the run's committed copies, and `retryReproduces` checks every retry decision against the run's

edits.early returns: guards added (an `if` without `else` whose branch returns), in the function that held the ternary or its callback; `one-line guards` when one is written `if (x) return y;` without braces
edits.if/else with a variable: a new `let` assigned in if/else branches, used where the ternary was
edits.helper with early returns: a new function (not a component) whose body has guards; also `helper (if/else)`, `helper with a switch`
edits.helper wrapping the inner ternary: a new function whose body is a single ternary (a gaming move)
edits.child component: a new capitalised function that returns JSX and is rendered as an element
edits.lookup object: an object literal indexed by a value, its values used as they are (every value built eagerly)
edits.lookup of functions: the same with functions as values, the one picked called
edits.&& / || chain: the ternary replaced by `&&`/`||` (in JSX: `{a && <X/>}` children)
edits.inner ternary moved to a variable: a new const initialised with the inner ternary (a gaming move)
edits.IIFE: an immediately invoked function in place of the ternary (a gaming move)
edits.nested ternary kept: as many nested ternaries as before
edits.suppression: a lint suppression comment was added
edits.comments or formatting only: the code (printed without comments) is the same
